title: Shopfront boundary trim — mixed Escallonia and Elaeagnus
summary: Twice-yearly cut on the seaward face of a listed-adjacent Old Town shopfront. Elaeagnus × ebbingei tidied to a 1.6m formal line, sea-facing Escallonia hand-shaped where the wind burn had thinned the top. All arisings out same day.

title: Front-garden box hedge replacement plan — Ethelbert Road CA
summary: Edwardian terrace inside the Ethelbert Road & Athelstan Road conservation area — old box collapsing to blight. Quoted removal plus replant with Ilex crenata 'Convexa'. Section-211 notice already filed on my side; work goes ahead late July.

title: Tamarisk reduction — sea-facing front boundary
summary: Staged reduction on an old Tamarix boundary that had gone leggy at the top and thin at the base. Took the height back 1.2m over the length, thinned the middle for wind passage. Second-stage cut booked for next February.
